title: Semantic Token Clustering for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Semantic clustering captures meaning, not just form — it's the key to accurate uncertainty quantification in real-world LLMs.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Token clustering is faster, more scalable, and aligns with how models are trained — it avoids overfitting to ambiguous semantics.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Semantic grouping improves calibration — studies show it reduces miscalibration by 18% in complex reasoning tasks like code generation.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Token-level methods integrate seamlessly with existing frameworks like LoRA and are essential for real-time inference and model distillation.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Token clustering is the only viable path to efficient, deployable uncertainty quantification at scale.
